verdict.rationale: Brex has a documented REST API covering transactions, expenses, receipts (upload/match), budgets, and webhooks, with token-based authentication using scopes (brex-docs-2, brex-docs-4, brex-docs-7, brex-docs-27, brex-docs-19). However, the auth mechanism is described as dashboard-generated 'user tokens' with scopes rather than a full OAuth flow, and an OpenAPI spec could not be located via standard endpoints (brex-probe-2). missing for 10: explicit OAuth 2.0 flow documentation (vs. static token generation), publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent developer corroboration of the API working as documented.
